title: catananche carpholepis
intro: Catananche carpholepis, commonly known as Cupid's dart, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, making it effective in treating various health issues such as arthritis, menstrual cramps, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Catananche carpholepis include its ability to relax muscles, reduce pain, and alleviate respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids have been identified in the plant, contributing to its medicinal properties.
